    FROM (
      SELECT status_history_id, old_status, new_status, remarks, changed_at

      WHERE lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET History"].json["query"]["lead_id"]}}'
      ORDER BY assigned_at ASC
    ) assign_row
  ) AS assignment_history;

=SELECT 
    l.lead_id,
    l.retailer_id,
    r.name AS retailer_name,
    r.mobile AS retailer_mobile,
    l.site_owner_name AS customer_name,
    l.site_owner_mobile AS customer_mobile,
    c.id AS customer_id,
    p.id AS painter_id,
    p.name AS painter_name,
    p.mobile AS painter_mobile,
    l.address_line1,
    COALESCE(l.address_line2, '') AS address_line2,
    l.town,
    l.state,
    l.pincode,
    TO_CHAR(f.followup_date, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS formatted_followup_date,
    TO_CHAR(f.followup_time, 'HH12:MI AM') AS formatted_followup_time,
    f.remarks
FROM followups f
JOIN leads l ON f.lead_id = l.lead_id
LEFT JOIN users p ON l.current_painter_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN users r ON l.retailer_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN users c ON l.site_owner_mobile = c.mobile AND c.user_type = 'CUSTOMER'
WHERE f.followup_id = '{{$node["Postgres - Log Followup"].json["followup_id"]}}'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: =SELECT product_id, sku_code, product_name, category, unit FROM products WHERE active = true ORDER BY category, product_name;

=WITH params AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - GET Products Knowledgebase"].json["query"]["leadid"]}}' ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' 
         THEN '{{$node["Webhook - GET Products Knowledgebase"].json["query"]["leadid"]}}'::uuid 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS target_lead_id,
    CASE WHEN '{{$node["Webhook - GET Products Knowledgebase"].json["query"]["userid"]}}' ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$' 
         THEN '{{$node["Webhook - GET Products Knowledgebase"].json["query"]["userid"]}}'::uuid 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS target_user_id
),
auth AS (
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM lead_detail_drilldown_view ldd, params p
    WHERE ldd.lead_id = p.target_lead_id 
      AND p.target_lead_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.target_user_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND (
        ldd.dso_id = p.target_user_id OR 
        ldd.dse_id = p.target_user_id OR 
        ldd.retailer_id = p.target_user_id OR 
        ldd.painter_id = p.target_user_id
      )
  ) AS authorized
)
SELECT 
  auth.authorized,
  CASE 
    WHEN auth.authorized THEN 
      COALESCE(
        (SELECT json_agg(prod.*) 
         FROM (
           SELECT product_id, sku_code, product_name, category, unit, description, specifications, segment, tags 
           FROM products 
           WHERE active = true 
           ORDER BY category, product_name
         ) prod
        ), '[]'::json
      )
    ELSE '[]'::json
  END AS list
FROM auth;

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
    v.estimate_id,
    v.lead_id,
    v.painter_id,
    v.estimate_version,
    v.material_total,
    v.labour_cost,
    v.discount,
    v.grand_total,
    v.submitted_at,
    v.estimate_item_id,
    v.product_id,
    v.quantity,
    v.rate,
    v.line_total,
    v.sku_code,
    v.product_name,
    v.category,
    v.unit,
    l.site_owner_name,
    l.address_line1,
    COALESCE(l.address_line2, '') AS address_line2,
    l.town,
    l.state,
    l.pincode,
    pn.name AS painter_name,
    rn.name AS retailer_name
FROM leads l
JOIN estimate_details_view v ON l.latest_estimate_id = v.estimate_id
LEFT JOIN users pn ON l.current_painter_id = pn.id
LEFT JOIN users rn ON l.retailer_id = rn.id
WHERE l.lead_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Latest Estimate"].json["query"]["lead_id"]}}'
  AND (
      l.current_painter_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Latest Estimate"].json["query"]["user_id"]}}' OR
      l.retailer_id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Latest Estimate"].json["query"]["user_id"]}}' OR
      l.site_owner_mobile IN (SELECT mobile FROM users WHERE id = '{{$node["Webhook - GET Latest Estimate"].json["query"]["user_id"]}}' AND user_type = 'CUSTOMER')
  )
ORDER BY v.category, v.product_name;
